content.text: In Zimbabwe, digital creators face a significant [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe|The Full]] challenge: being locked out of Stripe and PayPal. This exclusion hampers their ability to sell digital products online. However, with the emergence of sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can now build and deploy their own crypto stores, free from the constraints of traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to options]]-ethiopian-digital-creators-only-real|payment]] platforms. This shift towards infrastructure sovereignty enables creators to own their online stores, process payments in cryptocurrencies, and deliver products instantly, all without relying on third-party services.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The sovereign commerce infrastructure works by leveraging decentralized technologies such as blockchain and cryptocurrencies. This approach allows creators to build online stores that are resilient to platform failures and restrictions. With the ability to process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments, creators can tap into a global market without the need for traditional payment gateways. This infrastructure is particularly beneficial for creators in regions where financial exclusion is rampant, providing them with an alternative means to monetize their digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you need a few essential components. First, you'll need a domain name to host your store. Second, you'll require a GitHub or Cloudflare account to host your store's frontend. Third, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account to enable cryptocurrency payments. Lastly, you'll need a digital product to sell, such as an ebook, course, or software. With these components in place, you can begin building your sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your online store. This process typically involves generating an API key, configuring payment buttons, and setting up webhooks to automate order fulfillment. With the Edge Commerce Stack, this process is streamlined, and you can have your payment and delivery pipeline up and running within 48 hours. The stack includes everything you need to get started, from hosting to payment processing, ensuring a seamless deployment experience.
Build your crypto store in 48 hours.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, and your payment pipeline is configured, you can go live and start processing transactions. The first transaction is often the most exciting, as it validates the effectiveness of your infrastructure. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can process payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and many more. The stack's automated workflows ensure that orders are fulfilled instantly, providing a seamless experience for your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your crypto store involves optimizing your infrastructure for high traffic and large transaction volumes. This can be achieved by leveraging the scalability features of Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, which provide a robust and performant backend for your store. Additionally, you can optimize your payment pipeline by utilizing multiple payment gateways and currencies, reducing the risk of transaction failures. With the right infrastructure in place, you can focus on growing your business, knowing that your store can handle increased demand.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, offers a convenient and cost-effective solution for creators looking to build their own crypto stores. This stack includes everything needed to get started, from hosting to payment processing, and can be deployed within 48 hours.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, follow these steps: register a domain name, set up a GitHub or Cloudflare account, create a NOWPayments account, configure your payment pipeline, and deploy your store using the Edge Commerce Stack. With these steps completed, you can go live and start processing transactions. Additionally, ensure you have a digital product to sell and a basic understanding of cryptocurrency payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack is a comprehensive solution for building and deploying crypto stores, including hosting, payment processing, and automated workflows.
How long does deployment take?
Deployment typically takes 48 hours, depending on the complexity of your store and the speed of your setup.
What payment options are available?
The Edge Commerce Stack supports over 300 cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments, providing a wide range of payment options for your customers.
Is the Edge Commerce Stack scalable?
Yes, the stack is designed to scale with your business, leveraging the performance features of Cloudflare Pages and Supabase to handle high traffic and large transaction volumes.
What kind of support is available?
The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day support to help you get started and resolve any issues that may arise during deployment and operation.
